whole_pa_condition.reasoning: Judged only from these 40 sampled sheets, the condition is not met. PA2 itself is well covered from the batter's first visible frame through his departure, and Lindor's departure that closes PA1 is covered. What is missing sits at the end of PA1: the broadcast was on a full-screen STATCAST graphic through 152.169, so the pitcher's set and the start of the pitch that produced the groundout are absent from the material, and the defensive half of the play - the ground ball being fielded and the catch at first - never appears in a frame where it can be identified. The physical out can only be placed loosely between 157.174 and 158.675 from the first-base imagery; the clean 1-out score-bug change at 160.677 is a display event and is deliberately not used to establish it. In addition, Iglesias's entry into the box falls in a stretch where the broadcast was on the dugout, so the transition between the two plate appearances is covered in time but not in picture.

verdict.summary: The review's coverage and continuity conclusions survive: all 11 flagged jumps are correctly classified, the three unflagged scene changes are the only ones missing a flag, the score-bug count/outs progression and lower-third bounds are frame-accurate, Iglesias's first appearance at 180.247 already in the box is confirmed, and the whole-PA condition is correctly judged not met (mound hidden by the graphic through 152.169; fielding/catch at first not resolvable; no walk-in shown). However, a substantial set of per-tile evidence claims is refuted and must be corrected before the brackets are reused: PA2 pitch 1 leg lift is first seen at 184.701 (184.201 is the set), pitch 2 is already in leg lift at 199.533 (motion starts 199.282-199.533), pitch 3 shows no swing at 224.057 (bat through the zone only at 224.558), the P:5->96 MPH strip change is 153.670-154.171 not 153.170-153.670, the P:6->97 MPH and 96 MPH->P:8 changes are already in progress at 186.520 and 206.540, Lindor is still finishing his swing at the plate at 153.670 (running from 154.171), Iglesias is out of the CF frame by 228.562, sheet_cut_08's 'before' description does not match the frames (pitcher set on the rubber, batter upright, umpire reaching toward a Braves-white figure the review never mentions), and the plate area with small figures is visible below the PITCH USAGE panel. Swing-finish poses at 186.019 and 201.034 also contradict the 'swing vs take not resolvable' statements for PA2 pitches 1-2.
